classification.difficultyReason: Read the crossing of two supplied lines in each graph and report its integer x- and y-coordinates using the unit scales. All four parts apply the same direct graphical procedure.

content.prompt: For each of the following diagrams, find the coordinates of the point of intersection.

spec.description: Dotted unit grid, positive arrowed axes, integer ticks excluding zero, and two arrowed lines with matching coloured equations.
spec.mathematics: 3x+y=2 and x-5y=6; x and y ticks -3,-2,-1,1,2,3.
spec.answerVisibility: Both complete lines are supplied. No intersection marker or coordinate answer is added.

answer.worked: Read the crossing of the two lines: $x=1$ and $y=-1$. The point of intersection is $(1,-1)$.

spec.description: Dotted unit grid with x ticks -2,-1,1,2,3,4 and y ticks -4,-3,-2,-1,1,2. Two ascending arrowed lines have matching coloured equations.
spec.answerVisibility: Both complete lines are supplied. No intersection marker or coordinate answer is added.

answer.worked: Read the crossing of the two lines: $x=1$ and $y=-2$. The point of intersection is $(1,-2)$.

spec.description: Dotted unit grid with x ticks -1,1,2,3,4,5 and y ticks -3,-2,-1,1,2,3. Arrowed red ascending and blue descending lines have matching equations.
spec.answerVisibility: Both complete lines are supplied. No intersection marker or coordinate answer is added.

answer.worked: Read the crossing of the two lines: $x=3$ and $y=1$. The point of intersection is $(3,1)$.

spec.description: Dotted unit grid, integer ticks -3,-2,-1,1,2,3 on each axis, arrowed red ascending and blue descending lines, and matching equations.
spec.answerVisibility: Both complete lines are supplied. No intersection marker or coordinate answer is added.

answer.worked: Read the crossing of the two lines: $x=-1$ and $y=-1$. The point of intersection is $(-1,-1)$.
